ca78d89f83512ea4.description: About the Role Halian is seeking an experienced Appian Technical Lead / Solution Architect to join our team in Riyadh. This full-time role requires a professional with over 12 years of experience in Appian solution architecture and technical leadership. The successful candidate will be instrumental in translating business requirements into robust Appian solutions and guiding development teams. Key Responsibilities Translate business requirements into scalable Appian solution architectures, encompassing process design, security models, integration patterns, and data structures. Act as the Appian design authority, establishing development standards, governance frameworks, reusable components, and coding best practices. Define deployment architectures, including infrastructure, environments, sizing, HA/DR requirements, and cloud/on-premise considerations. Design integrations with core banking systems, CRM platforms, document management solutions, API gateways, and identity management platforms. Lead technical estimations, sprint planning, architecture reviews, and release planning activities. Manage non-functional requirements such as performance, scalability, security, auditability, and operational resilience. Conduct code reviews, health checks, and production readiness assessments. Represent the Appian platform in architecture governance forums, security reviews, and audit engagements. Mentor development teams and drive the adoption of new Appian capabilities, including Data Fabric, Process HQ, AI Skills, and Appian RPA. Experience in defining technical standards and governance for Appian development. Proficiency in integrating Appian with various enterprise systems. Technical Skills Strong understanding of Appian platform capabilities and best practices. Expertise in process design, security models, and data structures within Appian. Knowledge of integration patterns and API management. Familiarity with Appian Data Fabric, Process HQ, AI Skills, and Appian RPA. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. ca29329ccab6931f.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking an Engineer Naval Architect & Structural for a full-time position in Ras Tannurah, Eastern Region. This role is responsible for preparing and reviewing design analyses, calculations, and procedures for various structural engineering tasks within a marine shipyard environment. The incumbent will ensure the safety, efficiency, and reliability of critical engineering operations, focusing on both in-service and pre-service analyses. Key Responsibilities Prepare and review design analyses, calculations, and procedures for structural in-service and pre-service engineering deliverables, including hull structure design, transportation, lifting, installation, vessel deck layout and modification, hull structure erection, and ship lift. Demonstrate familiarity with project scope, specifications, schedule, and inter-discipline requirements, proactively addressing issues. Interface with other departments to gather input for discipline designs and drawings. Maintain close coordination with other disciplines and entities such as Engineering, Project Management Team, Procurement, Fabrication, and Construction. Assist in preparing estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and man-hour estimates. Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and ensure adherence to company procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements. Prepare discipline engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications as required. Participate in finalizing deliverables lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity. Attend project review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys as needed. Assist the procurement team in acquiring discipline equipment, materials, and services, ensuring compliance with company objectives and procedures. Review vendor and subcontractor submittals for compliance with project specifications, providing comments as necessary. Keep the supervisor informed of all technical, budgetary, and manpower-related activities and concerns. Provide input for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports, including associated productivity. Assist concerned parties with responses to the Company and other entities (*, certifying authorities, auditors, third parties) regarding their review and approval. Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience in the domain. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 3 to 6 years of experience in a similar role within shipbuilding or a related industry. Experience range: 2-5 years. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Ras Tannurah, Eastern Region, within the International Maritime Industries shipyard. The role involves collaboration with various internal departments and external entities to ensure project success.

ca3ca46684eba091.description: Job Summary GH Engage is seeking an experienced Electrical Superintendent to oversee electrical construction activities on a major project in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and involves supervising and coordinating electrical subcontractors, monitoring site progress, and ensuring installations are completed safely and efficiently according to project specifications. Key Responsibilities Supervise and coordinate assigned electrical construction activities and subcontractors on site. Ensure all works comply with project specifications, approved drawings, and construction standards. Coordinate daily site activities, ensuring proper planning and resourcing of work fronts. Support temporary site setup and construction mobilization as required. Monitor subcontractor performance and report issues affecting progress or productivity. Identify and escalate obstacles such as access restrictions, material shortages, and equipment availability. Maintain daily records of site activities and provide regular progress updates to the construction management team. Monitor material requirements, ensuring materials are correctly documented and suitable for works. Coordinate additional material requirements and ensure surplus materials are returned and recorded. Monitor progress against short-term construction programs and identify potential delays. Ensure subcontractors have necessary resources, materials, and access to complete assigned works. Support project change management and communicate issues affecting construction delivery. Quality, Health & Safety Compliance Ensure all construction activities comply with project health, safety, environmental, and quality requirements. Maintain clean, organized, and safe working areas, including appropriate waste management and environmental controls. Ensure site teams work with the latest approved construction drawings and documentation, removing outdated materials. Coordinate inspections with QA/QC teams to ensure installation works meet required quality standards. Support client inspections and ensure identified issues are addressed. Promote a strong safety culture and ensure subcontractors and site personnel follow all relevant procedures. Team Coordination and Communication Maintain regular communication with construction management and client representatives. Attend construction coordination meetings as required. Coordinate builders' work requirements with relevant site teams and other disciplines. Support the development of a productive and collaborative site working environment. Escalate construction, quality, safety, or program issues to the relevant management team. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience as an Electrical Supervisor or in a similar role on major construction projects. Demonstrated ability to supervise and coordinate electrical subcontractors effectively. Strong understanding of electrical construction activities, project specifications, and safety standards. Ability to monitor site progress, manage resources, and ensure quality standards. Compensation and Opportunities This role offers a competitive salary package based on experience and qualifications. It provides an opportunity to work on major construction projects in Saudi Arabia, gaining exposure to large-scale international construction environments, professional development, and career progression within a collaborative working environment.

ca4e77d322607641.description: About the Role Integrated Solutions Tawantech is seeking a Product & Technical Expert (PTE) for the Agentic AI in Contact Center project. This full-time role involves leading and managing product and technical tasks across three key components: the virtual AI bot/conversational IVR, agent-assist functionalities, and interaction analytics. The position requires 0-1 years of experience and focuses on building in-house capabilities through knowledge transfer. Role Purpose and Scope The Product & Technical Expert will oversee the project from requirements definition and vendor selection through solution design, integration, AI governance, and delivery oversight. A core responsibility is to ensure knowledge transfer to a nominated internal candidate, fostering long-term in-house expertise in Agentic AI solutions within the contact center environment. Key Responsibilities Manage and refine business and technical requirements for the virtual AI bot/conversational IVR, agent-assist, and interaction analytics components, maintaining requirements and compliance matrices. Develop and maintain use-cases and the intent-prioritization backlog (Tier 1 automated, Tier 2 AI-assisted, Tier 3 human), translating call-driver data into an automation roadmap. Define Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and success/acceptance criteria for project deliverables. Support RFP issuance, conduct technical evaluations of bidders, lead proofs-of-concept (including Saudi-dialect quality testing), and provide sourcing recommendations. Technically manage the implementation partner, including scope, statement of work, deliverables, and quality assurance. Manage conversational and agentic design elements such as open intent capture, dialog flows, prompts, tone/persona, escalation triggers, and warm-handoff behavior. Oversee the design of the RAG grounding approach, knowledge-base structure, and guardrail configuration. Define the target architecture and external/internal integration design across core banking (T24), CRM (MS Dynamics), Cortex, e-channels, OTP, and the Cisco IVR/ACD and speech-recording stack. Specify APIs, real-time context retrieval, latency targets, and the model-hosting approach. Advise on model selection (LLM/SLM and routing), RAG, hallucination mitigation, confidence thresholds, and prompt/version management. Establish the AI governance and guardrail framework aligned with SAMA and PDPL regulations, including human-in-the-loop for sensitive flows, audit trails, data residency, and PII redaction. Collaborate with Compliance, Risk, Legal, and Information Security teams to secure necessary approvals. Manage System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and phased go-live processes, including risk, issue, and dependency management. Establish analytics/AI-ops monitoring and reporting, and manage post-go-live operations. Coach and up-skill the nominated internal candidate (prospective AI-Ops Lead) and the wider team, producing runbooks and operational handover documentation. Experience and Qualifications 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability to manage product and technical tasks for complex AI projects. Experience with requirements gathering, vendor selection, and solution design. Familiarity with AI governance frameworks and compliance standards. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

ca7aedcd6c597e13.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a motivated Architecture and Urban Planning Engineer to join our client's team. This is a full-time position suitable for a fresh graduate with 0-1 years of experience, offering an opportunity to contribute to architectural design and urban planning projects. Role Overview The successful candidate will support various stages of architectural and urban planning initiatives. This role involves assisting in the preparation of design documents, contributing to project development, and coordinating with engineering teams to ensure project objectives are met. Key Responsibilities Assist in the preparation of architectural drawings, layouts, and design plans. Support urban planning and development projects. Prepare technical reports and project documentation. Assist in reviewing drawings and design specifications. Coordinate effectively with engineering and project teams. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Urban Planning, or a related field. Fresh graduate status; no prior work experience is required. Basic knowledge of AutoCAD and relevant design software. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Required Skills Good communication skills for effective team interaction. Demonstrated teamwork skills. Willingness to learn and develop professional skills within the field. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply. The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

caa78df9848ae788.description: About Tuwaiq Casting & Forging Company Tuwaiq Casting & Forging Company is seeking a Corporate Finance Director to join its Corporate Finance Department. This full-time position is based in Dammam, Eastern Region, and reports directly to the Chief Financial Officer. The role is critical for leading the company's corporate financing function and ensuring robust financial management. Role Overview The Corporate Finance Director will oversee treasury operations, liquidity management, funding arrangements, banking relationships, insurance, and financial risks. This position is responsible for securing adequate financing to support both operational and strategic requirements, while simultaneously optimizing funding costs, maintaining stringent financial controls, and safeguarding the company's overall financial position. Key Responsibilities Oversee treasury operations, cash management, payments, and banking transactions, including payroll and vendor disbursements. Lead cash flow forecasting and liquidity planning to meet operational, capital expenditure, and debt obligations. Optimize cash utilization, working capital efficiency, and returns on surplus cash investments. Ensure effective payment controls, segregation of duties, approval compliance, and reconciliations across ERP and banking systems. Establish and maintain treasury policies, controls, and reporting mechanisms. Funding and Banking Relations Develop and execute financing strategies, including shareholder funding, project financing, and working capital facilities. Lead financing negotiations with banks, lenders, shareholders, and financial institutions to optimize financing terms and costs. Manage banking relationships, financing agreements, debt schedules, facility utilization, and related reporting. Monitor financing covenants, lender requirements, and contractual obligations to ensure compliance. Lead refinancing, debt restructuring, and covenant waiver negotiations when required. Coordinate funding requirements, financial assessments, and financing proposals with senior management and shareholders. Prepare liquidity, financing, and debt reports for the CFO, senior management, Board, and shareholders. Insurance and Risk Management Oversee the company's corporate insurance portfolio, ensuring adequate coverage of operational, property, equipment, and contractual risks. Manage insurance brokers, insurers, policy renewals, negotiations, and claims. Identify, assess, and manage financial risks, including liquidity, interest rate, foreign exchange, and counterparty exposures. Ensure insurance coverage and financial risk management practices comply with financing obligations and company policies. Provide financial risk assessments and recommendations to support strategic decisions. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in corporate finance. Demonstrated strategic mindset and leadership capabilities in financial management.

ca415a2982b503ae.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة First Time London، المتخصصة في مجال مستحضرات التجميل، عن حاجتها لمندوبة مبيعات ميدانية في مدينة الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تعزيز المبيعات وتحصيل المستحقات ومتابعة العملاء ضمن فريق عمل متكامل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية زيارة العملاء الحاليين بشكل دوري لمتابعة احتياجاتهم وتلبية طلبات الشراء. عرض المنتجات وتقديم العروض التجارية المناسبة وإتمام عمليات البيع بفعالية. متابعة تحصيل المستحقات المالية من العملاء في المواعيد المتفق عليها. استقطاب عملاء جدد من الصيدليات ومحلات التجميل لتوسيع قاعدة العملاء. متابعة توافر المنتجات لدى العملاء وتحديد احتياجات إعادة الطلب لضمان استمرارية التوريد. تقديم تقارير دورية ومنتظمة عن الزيارات الميدانية، حجم المبيعات المحققة، وعمليات التحصيل. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات، ويفضل أن تكون في قطاع مستحضرات التجميل. القدرة على العمل الميداني والتنقل داخل مدينة الرياض. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل تتطلب العمل الميداني في مدينة الرياض. ستكون جزءًا من فريق مبيعات ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف الشركة وتوسيع حصتها في السوق. تفاصيل إضافية الراتب الشهري لهذا الدور يتراوح بين 3,750 ريال سعودي و 5,625 ريال سعودي. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمات واللاتي يستوفين المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

ca6fcebf387233ef.description: About Jumeirah Jumeirah is a global luxury hospitality leader and a member of Dubai Holding. The company operates a portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. Since the opening of Jumeirah Burj Al Arab in 1999, the brand has been recognized for its beachfront resorts, city hotels, and exclusive residences, providing distinctive experiences to guests worldwide. About the Role Jumeirah The Red Sea is seeking a Reservations Assistant Manager. This full-time position is open to Saudi National Talent and requires 3-4 years of relevant experience. The role focuses on ensuring service quality, commercial performance, and operational efficiency within the reservations department. Main Duties and Responsibilities Ensure internal and external service delivery, quality, and commercial performance align with Reservations KPI objectives. Collaborate with Sales, Revenue, and Hotel Operations teams to maximize revenue opportunities and minimize operational inefficiencies. Supervise and ensure the completion of daily, weekly, and monthly tasks related to reservations, audits, revenue, compliance, finance, visas, and group bookings. Identify and escalate risks related to revenue, finance, and guest experience to senior management for proactive resolution. Monitor and resolve guest complaints promptly by coordinating with relevant departments to ensure satisfactory resolution. Keep the department updated with property information, service offerings, new rates, and selling strategies to enhance operational efficiency. The benefits package includes financial incentives, comprehensive healthcare, and opportunities for professional development.

cab8bf9283ae468d.description: About StellaStays Inc StellaStays Inc, established in 2019, operates in the hospitality sector, providing tech-driven, furnished living spaces for short and long-term stays. The company aims to offer modern, effortless living solutions across the MENA region, focusing on seamless online booking and immediate move-in experiences. Role Overview StellaStays Inc is seeking a Front Desk Coordinator to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time position requires an individual with strong organizational and coordination skills to manage daily operations, ensure positive guest experiences, and facilitate communication among various stakeholders. The role is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Conduct daily check-in/out inspections to ensure property readiness and guest satisfaction. Oversee in-house inventory management and stock counts to maintain adequate supplies. Supervise maintenance and cleaning teams, ensuring efficient scheduling and high-quality work. Coordinate repairs and maintenance tasks promptly to minimize guest disruptions. Prepare and adhere to daily, weekly, and monthly reports on property operations and guest feedback. Ensure compliance with property documentation requirements and quality assurance standards. Respond promptly and professionally to on-ground guest requests, ensuring their needs are met. Handle add-on service requests and coordinate with relevant service providers. Source and manage reliable service providers and vendors, negotiating favorable contracts. Maintain data control and confidentiality of sensitive information. Greet visitors, clients, and partners, providing a professional and welcoming atmosphere. Answer and direct incoming calls, taking accurate messages when necessary. Manage incoming and outgoing mail and packages. Maintain the tidiness and appearance of the reception area. Assist with ad hoc administrative tasks as needed. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred). Proven experience in Operations and Front Desk management, preferably in the hospitality industry. Strong organizational and multitasking abilities, with attention to detail. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact effectively with guests and stakeholders. Proficient in using property management systems and other relevant software. Ability to work independently and make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment. Work Environment This role operates within a fast-paced, high-growth environment where team members are encouraged to contribute to the company's vision of modern living. The position is based in Riyadh and is a full-time commitment. Application Process Candidates interested in this Front Desk Coordinator position are invited to apply. We look forward to reviewing your qualifications.

cacfee16bd95075c.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Director - Commercial Partnerships to lead all commercial activities for a heritage and cultural program. This full-time role involves overseeing partnerships, sponsorships, retail, and overall revenue generation, with a focus on achieving financial targets and integrating commercial opportunities across programming and operations. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute the commercial strategy, defining revenue models across sponsorships, retail, F&B, ticketing, and activations. Lead revenue planning, forecasting, and target setting in coordination with Finance & Performance, ensuring alignment with cultural programming and financial expectations. Drive the delivery of revenue targets and continuously optimize revenue streams through pricing, product mix, and commercial innovation. Develop and manage a structured sponsorship and partnership strategy, identifying, negotiating, and securing high-value agreements. Design sponsorship packages in collaboration with Programming and Marketing teams, integrating them with cultural programming and visitor experiences. Manage relationships with sponsors, partners, government entities, and cultural partners, ensuring contractual obligations are met and value is realized. Oversee all retail, F&B, and commercial activations, defining the commercial mix, tenant strategy, and space allocation. Manage the performance of operators and vendors to ensure quality, compliance, and revenue delivery, aligning commercial offerings with cultural programming. Collaborate with Programming to embed commercial opportunities within cultural experiences and ensure programming supports revenue generation. Monitor and analyze performance across all revenue streams, tracking KPIs such as revenue per visitor and conversion rates, and implementing corrective actions. Oversee commercial vendor and operator selection in coordination with Procurement, managing contracts and performance agreements. Align commercial strategy and performance with Asset Management direction and coordinate with Group functions as required. Key Success Metrics Success in this role will be measured by revenue generation and achievement of targets, the value of sponsorships and partnerships secured, and the overall performance of retail and F&B operations. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience overseeing retail, F&B, or commercial operations within large-scale venues, events, or destinations. Strong understanding of commercial mix, tenant strategy, operator management, performance optimization, and revenue generation through on-ground activations. Experience working within large-scale events, festivals, entertainment platforms, or destination/precinct-based environments. Ability to link visitor experience with revenue generation. Proficiency in revenue planning, forecasting, performance tracking, and commercial KPIs (*, revenue per visitor, conversion, yield). Demonstrated ability to use data and insights to optimize commercial performance. Proven experience leading commercial teams and managing cross-functional collaboration. Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure environments and complex, multi-stakeholder settings. Experience working with government entities and large organizations is preferred. cad66f9ab8669862.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Manager, Bridges & Structure AG to oversee the inspection, maintenance, operational readiness, and lifecycle performance of bridges, tunnels, and associated structural assets within Qiddiya City. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to ensure the safety, serviceability, and resilience of structural assets through risk-based inspections, technical assurance, and effective contractor oversight. The Manager will be responsible for addressing structural defects, prioritizing rehabilitation efforts, and managing operational handover processes, while coordinating with specialist system owners on tunnel safety and maintenance interfaces. Key Responsibilities Develop and manage risk-based inspection, maintenance, and condition-assessment programs for bridges, tunnels, and associated structures. Oversee the investigation and remediation of structural deterioration, cracking, corrosion, water ingress, and other critical defects. Coordinate specialist structural assessments, load evaluations, monitoring, and testing to inform engineering recommendations. Manage maintenance contractors and technical consultants to ensure adherence to agreed scopes, quality standards, budgets, and service levels. Prepare lifecycle forecasts, renewal priorities, and investment proposals based on asset condition and risk assessments. Lead operational input into design reviews and handover processes, verifying maintainability, documentation, training, and defect closure. Coordinate tunnel-system interfaces, planned closures, and incident support, including reporting asset performance and escalating material risks. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant professional experience. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

cac63fedce8bb7e7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة SCREENS TECHNOLOGY عن مندوبي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتوفر منصبان (للرجال والنساء) في هذا الدور الذي يركز على المبيعات الهندسية ومشاريع التجزئة والفعاليات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2-5 سنوات، وهو متاح بدوام كامل مع نظام عمولات تحفيزي. المهام والمسؤوليات مبيعات المشاريع: بناء وإبرام صفقات مع قطاع المقاولات، الشركات الكبرى، وشركات صندوق الاستثمارات العامة (PIF). مبيعات التجزئة: تطوير وتوسيع شبكة العملاء لقطاع التجزئة والحلول التجارية. قطاع الفعاليات: استهداف وإدارة وتنفيذ استراتيجيات البيع والتأجير لقطاع الفعاليات والمؤتمرات في جميع مراحلها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية مثبتة في قطاع المقاولات (Construction & Contracting Sector). خبرة متخصصة في مبيعات تقنيات الشاشات (LED Screens) أو المجالات التقنية والهندسية ذات الصلة. معرفة وعلاقات قوية في قطاع المقاولات، المشاريع، أو تنظيم الفعاليات وشركات صندوق الاستثمارات. القدرة على إدارة دورة المبيعات كاملة، من التنقيب والتخطيط إلى إغلاق الصفقات وإدارة العقود. المهارات الأساسية مهارات تواصل ممتازة. مهارات تفاوض فعالة. القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية قوية. المزايا والحوافز يُحدد الراتب الأساسي بناءً على المقابلة الشخصية والخبرة. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، يتضمن الدور نظام عمولات تحفيزي قوي جداً يشمل: عمولات فورية على صفقات المبيعات. مكافآت وعمولات تصاعدية عند تحقيق الأهداف المطلوبة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في الرياض، ويوفر فرصة للمشاركة في مشاريع مؤثرة ضمن فريق مبيعات متخصص.

cad009066f935f1c.description: About the Internship Amazon Saudi Arabia is offering a Facilities Coordinator Intern position within the Reliability Maintenance Engineering team in Jeddah. This internship provides an opportunity to contribute directly to site productivity and operational success by ensuring equipment availability and performance. The role is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience, offering a practical learning environment within a global company focused on customer-centricity. Internship Experience As an intern, you will be paired with a mentor and gain exposure to an impactful project. The program facilitates engagement with Amazon employees for both personal and professional development, network expansion, and participation in activities with other interns. This internship provides the tools necessary to manage your project and learn in a real-world operational setting. Key Responsibilities Provide supervision and leadership to Facility Supervisors. Develop preventive and predictive maintenance plans for Fulfillment Center (FC) assets, including material handling and automation systems. Install, maintain, and troubleshoot electrical, control, and mechanical systems. This includes relay logic, ladder diagrams, control components, sensors and scanners, motor starters, relays, limit switches, electronic sensors, servo drives, frequency inverters, linear drives, sorters, and various mechanical components such as rolls, bearings, and belts. Act as a safety ambassador within the team and promote safe working practices across the site. Manage daily engineering and soft services, including housekeeping and premises upkeep. Oversee employee health and safety, and ensure statutory compliance for the Fulfillment Centre, including waste management and hazardous waste management according to bylaws, and timely renewal of licenses. Internship Details and Requirements Candidates should be available to commence the internship in Q2 2027. The internship requires availability for 3 to 6 months, on a full-time basis (40 hours per week). Experience required: 0-1 years. Career Progression This internship is suited for individuals who are curious and eager to learn. Successful interns may be considered for a graduate role upon completion of their university studies.

cad6f007313f8519.description: المهام والمسؤوليات: إدارة والإشراف على عمليات الصهر والصب والسبك. تخطيط الإنتاج ومتابعة تحقيق المستهدفات الإنتاجية. الإشراف على تشغيل وصيانة المعدات والأفران وخطوط الإنتاج. مراقبة جودة المنتجات وتقليل الهدر والفاقد. تطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية (HSE). إدارة الفرق الفنية وتطوير كفاءة العاملين. المتطلبات: بكالوريوس هندسة ميكانيكية أو هندسة مواد أو تعدين أو تخصص ذي صلة. خبرة إجمالية لا تقل عن 8 سنوات في القطاع الصناعي. خبرة لا تقل عن 5 سنوات في إدارة وتشغيل المسابك وعمليات صهر وصب المعادن. معرفة فنية بعمليات صهر وسبك الحديد والألومنيوم وأنظمة المسابك. خبرة في إدارة الإنتاج والصيانة والجودة والسلامة الصناعية. مهارات قيادية عالية والقدرة على إدارة فرق العمل وحل المشكلات التشغيلية.

ca1924aa0129e6ac.description: We looking for a Senior IT Operation Specialist to own our identity, device management, and endpoint security platforms end to end. You will manage JumpCloud, Google Workspace, MDM, DLP, and EDR across corporate and operational devices, and ensure our technical controls meet NCA ECC and PDPL requirements. You will report to the IT Manager and work closely with the Cybersecurity & Data Protection team, Store Operations, End User Support, and IT Governance. Key Responsibilities Own and operate identity, MDM, and EDR platforms, including JumpCloud and Google Workspace IAM, device enrollment, access controls, security policies, and configuration standards Define and enforce device compliance, patching, endpoint security, DLP, and configuration baselines Identify non-compliant devices and drive remediation and continuous improvement Provide advanced troubleshooting across endpoints, identity, authentication, device management, and security tooling, coordinating with internal teams and vendors Support security incident investigation and remediation related to managed platforms Maintain technical controls, documentation, and evidence supporting NCA ECC and PDPL compliance Mentor junior specialists, review their work, and maintain operational procedures and technical documentation 4+ years of experience in IT operations, endpoint management, IAM, or security operations Strong hands-on experience with MDM/UEM, identity management, and EDR platforms Strong knowledge of Windows and macOS administration, troubleshooting, patching, and security controls Experience managing IAM, SSO, MFA, access controls, and user/device lifecycle management Working knowledge of DLP, endpoint security, and security incident investigation and remediation Good understanding of NCA ECC and PDPL requirements and their application to IT operations Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field

cac117669af64522.description: نبحث عن مساعد إداري منظم ودقيق للانضمام إلى فريقنا، للمساهمة في دعم العمليات اليومية للمكتب. ستشمل مهامك تنظيم الملفات، وجدولة المواعيد، والتعامل مع المراسلات، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الدعم اللوجستي اللازم. إذا كنت تتمتع بمهارات تنظيمية عالية وقدرة على العمل بكفاءة، فنحن ندعوك للتقديم المهام الإدارية والتنظيمية إدارة وتنظيم جدول الأعمال والمواعيد اليومية للإدارة. تنسيق الاجتماعات وإعداد الدعوات وحجز قاعات الاجتماعات. إعداد جداول الأعمال (Agenda) وتدوين محاضر الاجتماعات (Minutes of Meeting). متابعة تنفيذ القرارات والتوصيات الصادرة من الاجتماعات. تنظيم الملفات الورقية والإلكترونية وأرشفة المستندات. إدارة المراسلات الواردة والصادرة. إدارة المكاتب الإشراف على سير العمل اليومي داخل المكتب. متابعة احتياجات المكتب من المستلزمات وطلبها عند الحاجة. التنسيق مع شركات الخدمات والصيانة. استقبال الزوار وترتيب مواعيدهم مع الإدارة. الدعم التنفيذي تقديم الدعم المباشر للمدير أو الإدارة العليا. تجهيز التقارير والعروض التقديمية. جمع وتحليل البيانات المطلوبة لاتخاذ القرار. متابعة المهام اليومية للإدارة والتأكد من إنجازها في الوقت المحدد. الحفاظ على سرية المعلومات والوثائق. إعداد التقارير إعداد التقارير الإدارية الدورية. متابعة مؤشرات الأداء (KPIs). إعداد تقارير المصروفات والموازنات البسيطة. تحديث قواعد البيانات والسجلات. المتابعة الإدارية متابعة العقود والمستندات الرسمية. متابعة تجديد الاشتراكات والتراخيص. متابعة الموافقات الداخلية. متابعة المواعيد النهائية للمشاريع والمهام. إدارة الوثائق إعداد النماذج الإدارية. مراجعة المستندات قبل اعتمادها. حفظ العقود والاتفاقيات بطريقة منظمة. ضمان سهولة الوصول إلى الملفات عند الحاجة.

ca5859b5937b9c14.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صروح الاستثمار للمقاولات عن فني أجهزة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بالإضافة إلى دعم مهندسي الإلكترونيات في أنشطة البحث والتطوير. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بما في ذلك الدوائر وعناصر التحكم والآلات، ومراقبة أدائها. دراسة المخططات الهندسية لتحديد نوع وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة اللازمة للمشاريع. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والميكانيكيين والحرفيين الآخرين المشاركين في تركيب الأجهزة الإلكترونية. اختبار الأجهزة الإلكترونية بعد التركيب لضمان مطابقتها للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية للصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلفيات المحتملة، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. تقديم الدعم الفني والمساعدة لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في جهود البحث والتطوير المتعلقة بالأجهزة الإلكترونية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الفنية. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ عمل الأجهزة والدوائر الإلكترونية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر هذا الدور في تبوك، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة صروح الاستثمار للمقاولات. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات فنية قوية في تركيب وصيانة الأجهزة الإلكترونية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها بفعالية. مهارات تواصل جيدة للعمل ضمن فريق وتقديم المساعدة التقنية. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة صروح الاستثمار للمقاولات.

caa41d2b215f8610.description: About the Role Holool Aloula (NCBS National Company for Business Solutions) is seeking a Contact Center Operations Manager to oversee and manage all contact center operations. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily contact center operations across inbound and outbound channels to achieve service levels and operational targets. Develop and implement operational strategies to enhance productivity, efficiency, and customer satisfaction. Manage and lead contact center supervisors, team leaders, and operational staff, ensuring effective performance and accountability. Monitor key operational KPIs, including Service Level, Average Handling Time (AHT), First Call Resolution (FCR), Abandonment Rate, and Customer Satisfaction (CSAT). Ensure optimal workforce planning and resource allocation in coordination with Workforce Management (WFM). Review operational reports and performance trends, identify gaps, and implement corrective action plans. Ensure compliance with client requirements, contractual obligations, internal policies, and operational procedures. Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance processes, reduce operational costs, and improve service delivery. Coordinate with Quality Assurance, Training, Workforce Management, IT, and other departments to address operational challenges. Oversee operational escalations and ensure timely resolution of critical customer and business issues. Support recruitment, onboarding, training, and development plans to maintain operational capacity and workforce readiness. Manage operational budgets and ensure efficient utilization of available resources. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field. Proven experience managing large-scale contact center operations, preferably in an outsourced or BPO environment. Strong understanding of contact center technologies, CRM systems, WFM tools, and performance management platforms. Experience managing client-facing operations and SLA-driven environments. ca126e93219d8f15.description: About ABB and the Role ABB is seeking an OT Security Analyst for its Electrification (EL) division. This full-time position is based in Makkah, specifically covering operations in Jeddah and Makkah. The role supports ABB Electrification's global OT security operations across worldwide factories and operational sites, contributing to the Regional Security – AMEA / Head of Information Security & Compliance – EL. Role Purpose and Context The OT Security Analyst acts as a coordinator and facilitator, bridging global OT security services, country-level Information Security (IS) teams, and factory operations. The primary objective is to ensure cohesive and consistent OT security management. This involves responsibility for OT device onboarding, vulnerability management, asset visibility, compliance support, and stakeholder reporting, all in alignment with ABB IS policies, standards, and global OT security frameworks. Key Responsibilities Facilitate and support the onboarding of OT devices onto Intrusion Detection System (IDS) platforms, including Nozomi and Claroty, across global factory sites. Configure and maintain OT security modules within ServiceNow (SNOW) for asset and incident management. Generate and analyze vulnerability reports from IDS platforms, contextualizing findings for specific factory OT environments. Coordinate remediation efforts with factory and country IS teams, monitor progress, validate fix effectiveness, and track remediation status. Maintain accurate and comprehensive OT asset inventories across IDS platforms and ServiceNow, ensuring full asset visibility. Support periodic OT security assessments, compliance checks, and audit activities to ensure adherence to ABB IS policies and OT security standards (ISA/IEC 62443, NIST CSF). Provide weekly status updates on onboarding progress, vulnerability management activities, and key risks to relevant stakeholders. Act as the primary liaison between global OT security services, country IS teams, and factory operations. Set up and improve local engagement processes to coordinate with global OT security services and meet compliance goals. Ensure all activities comply with ABB Regulations, ABB Group IS Guidelines, and applicable security policies, maintaining audit readiness. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in OT security or a related field. Demonstrated experience with IDS platforms such as Nozomi and Claroty. Familiarity with ServiceNow for asset and incident management. Knowledge of OT security standards including ISA/IEC 62443 and NIST CSF. Experience in vulnerability management and remediation coordination. Ability to coordinate with diverse teams across different geographies. About ABB Electrification ABB Electrification provides leading electrical distribution and management technologies, solutions, and services. The portfolio includes medium- and low-voltage electrical components, switchgear, digital devices, enclosures, and circuit breakers. The division partners with customers to advance power delivery and security, improve energy management, raise efficiency, and support reliable operations towards a low-carbon society. Application Information Candidates interested in this role are encouraged to apply. Further information about ABB and its global impact can be found at *********

ca1c6310779a7009.description: About the Role Wood is seeking an experienced Project Engineering Manager to lead and coordinate small to mid-range projects within the fertilizers (phosphate, ammonia, urea) and mining & metals sectors (aluminum, gold, copper) in Saudi Arabia. This full-time, office-based position focuses on engineering oversight, project planning, technical coordination, cost and schedule control, procurement support, and stakeholder alignment. The role manages projects through concept development, feasibility assessment, basic engineering, detailed design oversight, procurement follow-up, and preparation for execution, ensuring all engineering deliverables meet quality, cost, and schedule objectives. This position emphasizes office-driven project leadership with strong coordination between engineering teams, internal departments, and site representatives, and does not involve direct construction management. Occasional short visits may be required for specific technical reviews. Key Responsibilities Manage P&L with associated commercial and financial accountability, including revenue delivery, margin and overhead management, budget and forecast determination, risk and opportunity reviews, cost controls, accounts payable/billing, and cash collection. Contribute to and review project proposals and plans to determine timeframe, procedures, staffing requirements, and resource allocation. Negotiate changes to project scope or specifications with customers and follow the Change Management process for modifications to scope, cost, schedule, and quality. Pursue and develop opportunities for innovation, such as digitalization, technology use, work share, and high-value engineering centers. Establish project procedures and lead the production of project execution plans, including scope of work, deliverables list, master schedule, budget, organizational charts, and risk register. Report project progress regularly to senior management and/or customers. Ensure delivery of agreed schedule and financial performance, proactively intervening to prevent slippage. Ensure the competence of project team members to carry out assigned work. Lead ongoing focus on risk identification and mitigation during project execution. Be responsible for project HSSE leadership, ensuring a program of initiatives and auditing schedule are established and that HSSE and quality management issues are proactively addressed. Guide and direct a multidiscipline project team, which may include external specialists and staff from multiple offices and sites. Promote and establish a performance improvement culture and actions on complex projects and within their supply chains. Facilitate the setup of information management systems/applications as applicable to suit various life phases of projects and manage the information management project team. Participate in assurance activities and peer reviews. Leadership Responsibilities Champion and role model ethical behavior and compliance with applicable laws and policies. Oversee proposals and call-offs (which may be individual projects) within the delegation of authority, ensuring compliance with contracting policy and standards of ethical conduct. Coach, mentor, and empower others to make decisions within established parameters. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 20 years of experience in project management or project engineering roles. Demonstrated experience in the fertilizers (phosphate, ammonia, urea) and/or mining & metals (aluminum, gold, copper) sectors. Proven ability to manage projects through concept development, feasibility assessment, basic engineering, detailed design oversight, and procurement follow-up. Strong understanding of project planning, technical coordination, cost and schedule control, and stakeholder alignment. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Saudi Arabia.

ca1de0d6652f03bb.description: About the Role Johnson & Johnson MedTech is seeking a Senior Product Specialist for the DUALTO System. This full-time position is based in Makkah, with responsibilities covering Jeddah and Makkah. The role focuses on driving commercial growth, clinical adoption, and strategic positioning of the DUALTO Energy System, combining capital equipment sales with clinical and technical expertise. ca2fa7978b4ae264.company_name: مؤسسة عبدالرحمن عبدالله محمد اليوسف للتجارة
ca2fa7978b4ae264.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة بيت العرب الحديثة عن مدير إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في نجران. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على الأنشطة الإدارية وضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة عالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الإدارة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المدير الإداري مسؤولية المشاركة في تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية للشؤون الإدارية، والإشراف العام على الأنشطة الإدارية لضمان توافقها مع الخطط التشغيلية المعتمدة. كما يضمن توفير الموارد اللازمة لسير العمليات اليومية. المهام التفصيلية المشاركة في تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية للشؤون الإدارية، وتطوير وتنفيذ الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التي تساهم في تحقيق هذه الأهداف. التأكد من وجود الأطر والمقاييس الدقيقة لمتابعة مستوى تحقيق الخطط والأهداف. الإشراف على عمليات تطوير جداول الصلاحيات الإدارية والإجراءات المتبعة ومراجعتها باستمرار لتحسينها وضمان تقديم الخدمات الإدارية بالجودة والسرعة المطلوبة. الإشراف على تطبيق الأنظمة والتعليمات والقرارات الإدارية المتبعة في الجهة. ضمان إبلاغ الوحدات التنظيمية الأخرى والموظفين بكافة القرارات والتعليمات الإدارية الصادرة عن الإدارة العليا ومتابعة تنفيذها. إدارة القطاع وفقاً للعقد المبرم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الإدارة أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على تخطيط وتنظيم الأعمال الإدارية. فهم جيد للخطط التشغيلية والإجراءات الإدارية. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة في مدينة نجران، وتتطلب التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مجموعة بيت العرب الحديثة. تقديم الطلبات لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. للمهتمين، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للانضمام إلى فريقنا في نجران.

ca6be4d7163ac932.description: About the Role Qiddiya is seeking a Senior Manager Commercial (Development Accounting) to lead development accounting and commercial finance activities for development programs and projects. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and requires over 10 years of experience. The role ensures accurate financial reporting, cost governance, budget control, and financial performance management throughout the project lifecycle. Role Purpose and Context The Senior Manager will provide financial and commercial oversight of development expenditures, commitments, forecasts, and investment performance. This oversight supports informed decision-making and effective capital management. The role is also responsible for driving financial governance, compliance, and process excellence while supporting strategic development and commercial objectives. Key Responsibilities Lead development accounting activities across assigned development projects, portfolios, and capital investment programs. Oversee project cost accounting, capitalization processes, expenditure tracking, accruals, reconciliations, and financial reporting activities. Manage development budgets, forecasts, commitments, cash flow projections, and financial performance monitoring. Review and validate project-related financial transactions, contractor payments, consultant invoices, and capital expenditure allocations. Ensure compliance with accounting standards, capitalization policies, financial governance requirements, and internal controls. Collaborate with Development, Commercial, Project Delivery, Procurement, Treasury, and Finance teams to ensure financial alignment and reporting accuracy. Support business case development, investment evaluations, development feasibility assessments, and financial decision-making processes. Monitor project financial risks, funding requirements, cost variances, and forecast changes, recommending corrective actions where necessary. Lead month-end, quarter-end, and year-end development accounting activities and reporting requirements. Prepare financial reports, executive dashboards, management presentations, and governance submissions related to development performance. Coordinate audit activities and ensure the availability of accurate financial records, supporting documentation, and accounting evidence. Lead and develop development accounting teams while promoting continuous improvement, automation, and financial best practices. Required Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in development accounting and commercial finance. Key Interactions This role involves extensive collaboration with various internal and external stakeholders to ensure financial alignment and operational efficiency. caa2359618cc09fe.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصنع شركة الفرات للمياه عن مراقب جودة للانضمام إلى فريقه في الرياض، بمنطقة الحريق. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان جودة المنتجات من خلال جمع العينات وفحصها وتحليلها، بالإضافة إلى مراجعة سياسات وإجراءات الجودة ومراقبتها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع عينات المنتجات من مراحل مختلفة من عملية التصنيع، بما في ذلك المنتجات قيد التصنيع والمنتجات النهائية. إجراء الفحوصات اللازمة لعينات المنتجات، والتحقق من مدى التزامها بمعايير الجودة المطلوبة. توثيق النتائج التي يتم التوصل إليها بدقة ووضوح. تحديد مصادر العيوب المحتملة في المنتجات أو العمليات. تقديم التوصيات الفعالة للتخفيف من آثار العيوب وتحسين الجودة. تحديث سياسات وإجراءات الجودة بشكل دوري لضمان فعاليتها ومواكبتها لأفضل الممارسات. الحفاظ على الخبرات الفنية وتحديث المعرفة المتعلقة باتجاهات القطاع واللوائح الحكومية ذات الصلة. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال مراقبة الجودة أو مجال ذي صلة. يجب أن يكون المرشح قادراً على تطبيق المعرفة الفنية في جمع العينات وتحليلها، بالإضافة إلى فهم جيد لسياسات وإجراءات الجودة. بيئة العمل يعمل مراقب الجودة ضمن فريق مصنع شركة الفرات للمياه في الرياض، بمنطقة الحريق. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لضمان المراقبة الفعالة لعمليات التصنيع. ملخص الوظيفة يقوم مراقب الجودة بجمع وفحص وتحليل عينات المنتجات، ومراجعة ومراقبة سياسات وإجراءات الجودة لضمان الالتزام بالمعايير المطلوبة. يتضمن الدور تحديد مصادر العيوب وتقديم التوصيات لتحسين الجودة، مع الحفاظ على المعرفة الفنية وتحديثها. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل في مصنع شركة الفرات للمياه، حيث يتم تقدير المساهمة في الحفاظ على معايير الجودة العالية. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة.

Enter, process, and record invoices and financial documents into the accounting system. Reconcile cash advances and petty cash, ensuring all supporting invoices, receipts, and documents are accurate and properly verified. Review VAT calculations and ensure the correct application and recording of VAT on invoices. Maintain, organize, and archive financial documents, invoices, and accounting records. caeb9d911adadc14.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our team for an upcoming full-time opportunity in Saudi Arabia. This role focuses on mechanical engineering expertise, particularly within Shutdown / Turnaround (SD/TA) projects. Manage and maintain various mechanical static equipment, including heat exchangers, columns, pressure vessels, reactors, and pipelines. Utilize Primavera P6 for project scheduling and management. ca1b4342b8d007ef.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة بن لادن السعودية عن مدير جودة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى قيادة قسم مراقبة الجودة وضمان تنفيذ الفحوصات والاختبارات واعتماد الأعمال بكفاءة عالية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى مدير الجودة مسؤولية الإشراف على جميع جوانب ضمان الجودة، بما في ذلك التخطيط والتنفيذ والتحليل، لضمان التزام المشاريع بأعلى المعايير. توزيع مفتشي الجودة وتحديد مهامهم. اعتماد خطط الفحص والاختبار لضمان فعاليتها. متابعة تقارير عدم المطابقة (NCR) واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. التنسيق الفعال مع الاستشاريين لضمان توافق معايير الجودة. تحليل مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية للجودة وتقديم التوصيات لتحسينها. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك خبرة واسعة في إدارة الجودة، مع قدرة مثبتة على قيادة الفرق وضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال إدارة الجودة. فهم عميق لأنظمة ومعايير الجودة. قدرة على تحليل البيانات وتقديم تقارير دقيقة. بيئة العمل يعمل مدير الجودة ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، كجزء من فريق مجموعة بن لادن السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لضمان الإشراف المباشر على عمليات الجودة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة. نشجع المرشحين المؤهلين على تقديم طلباتهم.

Provide operational support to 3PL companies, addressing issues and obstacles. Manage 3PL invoices and payment releases. Drive efficient operations and service excellence by balancing supply and demand. Analyze future needs to proactively activate requirements and optimize SLA processes for 3PL companies. cab59cdf788d0540.description: About the Role FuntoNetwork Consulting is seeking a Solution Architect for an upcoming contract project opportunity in Riyadh. Accurate disclosure of conflicts, employment or subcontracting restrictions, and authorization to submit qualifications for this opportunity. cad390ef210b1fea.description: About Spring Health Spring Health is a provider of comprehensive mental health solutions for employers, focusing on connecting employees with appropriate care. The company offers a clinically validated solution designed to improve mental health outcomes, reduce recovery times, and lower healthcare costs through technology and qualified care providers. Spring Health operates with a mission-driven team supported by leaders in psychiatry. Role Overview: Psychotherapist / Psychologist (Part-Time, Hybrid) Spring Health is seeking qualified and internationally licensed mental health therapists to join its network of care providers in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a part-time contract position with a hybrid work model (remote and in-person), specializing in the care of minors. The role involves delivering care through a technology and AI/ML-powered platform, with a focus on patient outcomes. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Provide psychological counseling to clients through various benefit structures, including short-term Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and employer-provided health plans. Deliver therapy to adults who have completed evidence-based electronic assessments to identify symptoms and concerns. Maintain an updated calendar of availability and complete session documentation promptly within the scheduling system. Utilize evidence-based therapeutic techniques tailored to individual client needs. Collaborate with the care provider support team, clinical navigation team, and administrative care support team as needed. Provide compassionate and culturally aware care, adhering to diversity and inclusion values. Access to insights from evidence-based metrics to enhance care effectiveness. Join a community that supports professional development and contributes to the future of mental health care. cae51c6dea0b92cf.description: About Diaverum Saudi Arabia Diaverum is a multinational healthcare organization of Swedish origin, dedicated to providing renal care to patients with chronic kidney disease. With over 15,000 employees across 25 countries and more than 1,400 colleagues in 33 cities and towns across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Diaverum combines global experience with a strong local presence. The organization's vision is to transform renal care by broadening access to high-quality kidney care. The Role of Marketing and Communications Specialist Diaverum Saudi Arabia is seeking a Marketing and Communications Specialist to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves supporting the planning and execution of integrated marketing and communications initiatives across internal and external communications, brand management, digital channels, campaigns, and events. The specialist will work at the headquarter, cluster, and clinic levels, developing and coordinating content across various formats and channels. The position requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Support the planning and execution of integrated marketing and communication activities for both internal and external audiences. Develop and coordinate campaigns and content for key business priorities, services, events, exhibitions, and initiatives, including local activation of global campaigns. Draft and coordinate external communication materials such as corporate announcements, news stories, social media content, stakeholder materials, and media-facing content. Maintain consistent application of Diaverum’s brand identity, tone of voice, visual standards, and approved messaging across all communication materials and channels. Develop, adapt, and quality-check content and branded materials for digital, print, presentation, campaign, and event formats. Manage and coordinate Diaverum Saudi Arabia’s website, social media channels, digital screens, and other approved communication platforms. Coordinate internal communication across HQ, clusters, and clinics to ensure timely, relevant, and accessible organizational information for employees. Maintain and develop the SharePoint “Intranet” as an active platform for leadership communication, company updates, recognition, culture, onboarding, and organizational connection. Coordinate employee-facing communication and campaigns, including leadership messages, recognition activities, True Care initiatives, and employee wellbeing communication. Maintain the annual marketing and communications calendar, supported by rolling quarterly and monthly plans. Monitor campaign, channel, and communication performance, recommending practical improvements to reach, engagement, content, and delivery. Track timelines, dependencies, and communication risks, escalating matters requiring management input as needed. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a proactive, creative, and audience-focused communications professional with strong attention to detail and follow-through. This role requires the ability to work across functions, manage multiple priorities independently, and maintain quality in a fast-moving environment. Candidates should demonstrate sound judgment in sensitive or external-facing communication and approach challenges with a practical, solution-oriented mindset. Importance of the Role This role is central to making Diaverum's stories visible, connecting its people, strengthening its brand, and helping patients, partners, and stakeholders understand the organization's mission and impact. It offers an opportunity to contribute across the full marketing and communications agenda and shape how Diaverum Saudi Arabia communicates its purpose across all audiences and channels. Application Diaverum Saudi Arabia invites applications from hands-on marketing and communications professionals who excel at creating strong content, executing campaigns, and working across diverse audiences and channels.

ca31b9962cbd9b57.description: We are seeking a Valve Repair Specialist to join our Mechanical Services Shops. Mechanical Services Shops is responsible for providing rotating and static equipment repair and fabrication of components. Your primary role is to provide technical and on-hand support for inspection, repair, reconditioning, testing, and performance improvement of industrial valves. You will determine repair strategy, resolve complex leakage or operability problems, approve procedures, and ensure repaired valves meet standard, service, and reliability requirements. Key Responsibilities As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following: · Repair Strategy: Review valve type, service, damage, pressure class, materials, trim, actuator, and code requirements to establish inspection, repair, replacement, upgrade, and test scope. · Complex Troubleshooting: Diagnose seat leakage, packing leakage, galling, erosion, cavitation, corrosion, distortion, stem or guide problems, actuator issues, and recurring functional failures. · Procedure Development: Approve disassembly, dimensional inspection, machining, lapping, welding, heat-treatment, assembly, torque, setting, and acceptance criteria. · Testing & Certification: Define shell, seat, backseat, closure, fugitive-emission, torque, stroke, and functional tests; review calibrated data and certify results against applicable standards. · Technical Governance: Control deviations and material substitutions, support RCAs, standardize repair practices, mentor personnel, and recommend design or service improvements. Minimum requirements · You will hold a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Materials, Metallurgical, or Manufacturing Engineering from a recognized and approved program. · You will have at least 15 years of valve, pressure-equipment, or mechanical-repair experience, including a minimum of 10 years in complex industrial valve repair and testing. · Expertise across gate, globe, check, ball, butterfly, and other applicable valve types such as safety relief valves is required. Moreover, expertise in trim designs, packing systems, actuators, and pressure classes is required. · Strong knowledge of valve metallurgy, hard-facing, machining, lapping, welding repair, dimensional inspection, pressure testing, and leakage diagnosis is necessary. · Demonstrated ability to develop repair procedures, troubleshoot repeat failures, assess deviations, and optimize valve performance is required. · API valve training and recognized OEM repair, actuator, or diagnostic training are strongly preferred.

ca865330a2b98381.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة البقاع الأوسط للصناعة عن مدير إعلام رقمي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق استراتيجيات وأنشطة النشر عبر وسائل الإعلام الرقمية، مع التركيز على المحتوى والإعلانات والأداء العام. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة عمليات النشر الرقمي، بما في ذلك الإشراف على الموظفين والمرافق وإدارة الموازنات المخصصة. تحديد الاتجاه الاستراتيجي للمنشورات الرقمية، وتحديد الجمهور المستهدف، وصياغة الصورة المرغوبة للمحتوى. الإشراف على وضع الاستراتيجيات الرقمية وتنفيذها، وتحديد العناصر الأساسية للمحتوى. مراقبة جودة المحتوى الرقمي ونزاهته الصحفية، ووضع السياسات والإجراءات لضمان الجودة والإشراف على تطبيقها. إدارة الأنشطة الإعلانية، والإشراف على عمل موظفي التسويق والإعلان. بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء الرئيسيين والحفاظ عليها. إدارة العلاقات مع أصحاب المصلحة الخارجيين، مثل الوكالات الحكومية وهيئات التصنيف أو السلطات الرقابية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة بالإعلام الرقمي أو إدارة المحتوى. فهم قوي لاستراتيجيات النشر الرقمي وإدارة المحتوى. القدرة على إدارة الموازنات والإشراف على فرق العمل. نوع العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل، ويتطلب التواجد في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. نطاق المسؤولية يتحمل مدير الإعلام الرقمي المسؤولية الكاملة عن المحتوى والإعلانات المقدمة والأداء العام لجميع الأنشطة الرقمية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

caf9a887f3d03669.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة شمول الخليج للإستشارات المهنية عن مهندس مساحة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ أعمال المساحة المكتبية والميدانية لمختلف المشاريع، بما في ذلك المساحات الجيوديسية والطبوغرافية والمسح البحري. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية القيام بالأعمال المكتبية والميدانية المتعلقة بهندسة المساحة، بما في ذلك المساحات الجيوديسية والطبوغرافية والاستشعار عن بعد والمسح البحري. تنفيذ أعمال المسح اللازمة لمشاريع الأبنية والطرق وغيرها. رسم الخرائط والمخططات المساحية بدقة. متابعة تنفيذ المشاريع والتأكد من مطابقة المواصفات الفنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال وتقديم التوصيات اللازمة. إجراء الدراسات الاستطلاعية وإعداد شبكات المساحة المثلثية. الإشراف على تثبيت نقاط الاستناد المرجعية للمشاريع. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال هندسة المساحة. القدرة على العمل في البيئات المكتبية والميدانية. معرفة جيدة بتقنيات المساحة الجيوديسية والطبوغرافية والاستشعار عن بعد. بيئة العمل يعمل مهندس المساحة ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة شمول الخليج للإستشارات المهنية، ويشمل الدور مهاماً ميدانية ومكتبية في مشاريع متنوعة بالمنطقة الشرقية، وتحديداً في مدينة الخبر. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

ca7c2571d637aa4c.job_title: Restaurant Receptionist – Premium Neighbourhood Concept (Al Khobar)
ca7c2571d637aa4c.description: Job Details Location: Al Khobar, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent Department: Front of House (Reporting to the Restaurant Manager) Compensation: 6,000 SAR Monthly About the Opportunity We are exclusively partnering with an exquisite, casual neighbourhood dining destination in Al Khobar where French Riviera spirit meets everyday city life. Known for exceptional food, warm hospitality, and executing simple things beautifully, this concept is looking for a polished Receptionist to act as the ultimate gatekeeper of the guest experience. You will manage reservations, warmly welcome and farewell guests, and ensure the flow of the dining room feels effortless from the moment the doors open. ca99c71581744a9e.description: Job Objective: To plan and oversee the execution of all marketing campaigns and plans (digital and traditional) to enhance the company's brand, highlight real estate projects, attract potential buyers and investors, and support the sales team in achieving defined goals. cab235545e0c41bb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة يوتيليتي القابضة عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، تقدير المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذ الأعمال، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية لمختلف التطبيقات (المنزلية، الصناعية، التجارية) ومكوناتها. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة المطلوبة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة مع مطابقة مواصفاتها. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية وتشغيل الدارات، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، ومتابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع مراحل العمل. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بمواصفات المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وضمن فريق. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة يوتيليتي القابضة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور.

ca487e673184a85d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة برو فاست عن مساعد إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم لمدير المشروع في إدارة ومتابعة تنفيذ أعمال المشروع، والتنسيق الفعال بين مختلف الأطراف المعنية لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وجودة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مساعدة مدير المشروع في تخطيط والإشراف على تنفيذ الأعمال وفق البرنامج الزمني المعتمد. متابعة الأعمال اليومية في الموقع والتأكد من سير التنفيذ حسب المخططات والمواصفات المعتمدة. التنسيق بين المهندسين والمشرفين والمقاولين والموردين والجهات ذات العلاقة. متابعة تقدم الأعمال وإعداد التقارير الدورية عن حالة المشروع ونسب الإنجاز. متابعة البرنامج الزمني للمشروع ورصد أي تأخير أو معوقات ورفعها إلى مدير المشروع. مراجعة المخططات والمواصفات الفنية والتأكد من تنفيذ الأعمال وفق المتطلبات المعتمدة. متابعة طلبات المواد والمعدات والتأكد من توفرها في الوقت المناسب. التنسيق مع الاستشاري ومناقشة الملاحظات الفنية ومتابعة إغلاقها. متابعة أعمال المقاولين والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق العمل والجودة والبرنامج الزمني. المساعدة في متابعة أوامر التغيير والمطالبات والمستخلصات والمستندات المتعلقة بالمشروع. متابعة تطبيق اشتراطات الجودة والسلامة والصحة المهنية داخل المشروع. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بإدارة المشاريع أو الدعم الإداري للمشاريع. يجب أن يكون المرشح قادراً على العمل بدوام كامل في الرياض. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وتنسيقية ممتازة. القدرة على متابعة التفاصيل والالتزام بالمواعيد النهائية. مهارات تواصل قوية وفعالة مع مختلف الأطراف. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الدورية وتقديمها بوضوح. الإلمام بأساسيات إدارة المشاريع ومتابعة الجودة والتكلفة والسلامة. بيئة العمل سيعمل المساعد الإداري ضمن فريق المشروع في مدينة الرياض، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب التنسيق المستمر والتعاون مع المهندسين والمقاولين والاستشاريين لضمان تحقيق أهداف المشروع. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وسيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

cac18a8a71d48e25.description: Business Analyst BCM Role purpose We are seeking a Product / Business Analyst to define, validate, and improve a Business Continuity Management (BCM) software solution. You will bridge BCM practitioners, customers, product, UX, engineering, QA, and implementation teams—turning resilience, regulatory, and operational needs into clear, scalable product capabilities. The ideal candidate combines strong enterprise business-analysis skills with practical understanding of BIA, BCP, crisis management, disaster recovery, BCM exercises, recovery objectives, and resilience reporting. Key responsibilities Gather, analyze, prioritize, and document requirements from customers, BCM specialists, internal stakeholders, and delivery teams. Translate needs into epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, data requirements, and non-functional requirements. Define and improve BCM workflows covering BIA, recovery objectives such as RTO/RPO/MTPD, dependency mapping, continuity plans, crisis management, exercises, corrective actions, audits, and compliance evidence. Define calculation logic, scoring models, thresholds, recovery priorities, approvals, workflow rules, and dashboard/reporting KPIs. Conduct customer discovery sessions, workshops, demonstrations, design reviews, fit-gap assessments, and UAT. Partner with UX/UI to design intuitive, role-based BCM workflows for assessors, plan owners, approvers, crisis teams, auditors, and executives. Ensure enterprise usability requirements, including configurable templates, notifications, localization, Arabic/English support, bulk updates, imports, integrations, and reduced manual data entry. Define UAT scenarios and functional test cases; support sprint planning, backlog grooming, demos, defect triage, release validation, and release documentation. Work with engineering and QA to validate permissions, business rules, calculations, audit trails, approvals, notifications, reports, and data integrity. Required qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Risk Management, or a related discipline. 4+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Product Owner, Implementation Consultant, or similar role in enterprise SaaS, GRC, risk, resilience, cybersecurity, or workflow products. Strong experience gathering, documenting, validating, and prioritizing functional and non-functional requirements. Ability to collaborate effectively with senior business stakeholders, domain experts, designers, engineers, and QA teams. Preferred qualifications Experience with BCM, GRC, ERM, operational resilience, internal audit, disaster recovery, or compliance software. Familiarity with ISO 22301, ISO 31000, ISO 27001, NIST, BCI Good Practice Guidelines, DRI practices, or similar frameworks. Experience in Saudi Arabia or GCC enterprise environments, especially regulated industries. Knowledge of SSO, SAML, OAuth/OIDC, RBAC, audit logs, and enterprise integration patterns. Familiarity with REST APIs, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Automate, Microsoft Teams, CMDBs, HR systems, ERP systems, or ticketing platforms. Relevant certifications such as CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, Scrum/Agile, ISO 22301 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CBCI, or DRI certifications.
